test_case.purpose: Validate NVIDIA processor fatal uncorrectable-error detection and platform containment while preserving the source's intended CPU RAS coverage, once the missing injection and acceptance contract is supplied.
required_package: Pinned authoritative NVIDIA/platform processor RAS injection tool, specification, version and checksum
Supported CPU/platform/firmware/OS matrix and exact target/socket/core/error-index mapping
Fatal UCE command and proof of its error type and trigger point
Expected containment, reset/power action, BERT/CPER/MCA/SEL fields and timing
Independent console/OOB access, boot-loop escape and recovery image/procedure
Post-recovery CPU inventory, topology, firmware, workload and persistent-state acceptance
